summary: Same Game Parlay on Monday Night Football: Dallas against a backup-QB Eagles team missing two starting WRs, its lead back scoring, and Pickens clearing a low 40-yard bar. It had the highest joint chance of any allowed combo, but about 1 in 3 is far from a lock.
